dialect.detail: Compuware Xpediter/TSO demo program (CWXTCOB), designed for IBM mainframe TSO/batch environment with JCL references and SAMPLIB. Uses LABEL RECORDS, RECORDING MODE IS F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0, LINKAGE SECTION with PARM, GOBACK, and COMP-3.
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with PARMINFO PIC S9(4) COMP
comment references XPEDITER/TSO SAMPLIB and JCL

purpose.domain_detail: Compuware Xpediter/TSO training and debugging demo program processing employee wage data and producing compensation and regional sales reports
purpose.summary: CWXTCOB is a Compuware Xpediter/TSO demo/training program that reads an employee file containing hourly, sales, and management records, calculates compensation (including overtime and commission via called subprograms), stores results in a hold table organized by region, and prints an Employee Compensation Report and a Regional Sales Report. It intentionally contains records that cause abends (S0C7) for debugging training purposes.

notable_features: Two-dimensional OCCURS table (HOLD-TABLE) with SET/indexed access
CALL to external subprograms CWXTSUBC (commission calc) and CWXTDATE (date/service calc)
LINKAGE SECTION with PARM-LTH/PARM-DATA for JCL PARM processing
REDEFINES for date fields and region name table
Intentional bad data records for Xpediter debugging training
COPY statements for EMPFILE, RPTEMP, RPTREGN copybooks
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (530 total lines); the print sections (6000-PRINT-EMPLOYEE-REPORT, 7000-PRINT-REGION-REPORT) are not visible but referenced. The program is a well-known Compuware Xpediter demo artifact widely distributed with mainframe tooling. Fixed format confirmed by max_line_length=72 and no long lines.
